title: Architecture-Agnostic Feature Synergy for Universal Defense Against Heterogeneous Generative Threats
abstract: arXiv:2603.14860v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Generative AI deployment poses unprecedented challenges to content safety and privacy. However, existing defense mechanisms are often tailored to specific architectures (e.g., Diffusion Models or GANs), creating fragile "defense silos" that fail against heterogeneous generative threats. This paper identifies a fundamental optimization barrier in naive pixel-space ensemble strategies: due to divergent objective functions, pixel-level gradients from heterogeneous generators become statistically orthogonal, causing destructive interference. To overcome this, we observe that despite disparate low-level mechanisms, high-level feature representations of generated content exhibit alignment across architectures. Based on this, we propose the Architecture-Agnostic Targeted Feature Synergy (ATFS) framework. translated_title: 面向异构生成威胁通用防御的架构无关特征协同
translated_abstract: 生成式AI的部署给内容安全和隐私带来了前所未有的挑战。然而，现有的防御机制往往针对特定架构（如扩散模型或GAN）量身定制，形成了脆弱的“防御孤岛”，在面对异构生成威胁时会失效。本文指出了朴素像素空间集成策略中的一个根本性优化障碍：由于目标函数存在差异，来自异构生成器的像素级梯度在统计上趋于正交，从而产生破坏性干扰。为克服这一问题，我们观察到，尽管底层机制各不相同，生成内容的高层特征表示在不同架构之间表现出一致性。基于这一发现，我们提出了架构无关目标特征协同框架。通过引入目标引导图像，ATFS将多模型防御重新表述为一个统一的特征空间对齐任务，使……
tldr: 该论文提出ATFS框架，利用生成内容高层特征在不同架构间的内在一致性，将多模型防御转化为统一的特征空间对齐任务，从而实现对扩散模型、GAN等异构生成威胁的架构无关通用防御。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Architecture-Agnostic Targeted Feature Synergy (ATFS) framework, which reformulates multi-model defense as a unified feature-space alignment task by leveraging the cross-architecture alignment of high-level feature representations, enabling universal defense against heterogeneous generative threats such as diffusion models and GANs.
